$comment: PSI's inputs to the platform permissions generator (SEB authz/tools/gen/estate.py says what each key means). Estate mode: platform_dir is the installed bundle's authz/, whose core and autorizare modules psi never copies; psi's fga.mod lists only psi's modules. Generated artefacts live under estate/authz/. Run from psi's root: AUTHZ_ESTATE_ROOT=$PWD python3 .seb-bundle/authz/tools/generate.py --estate estate/authz.json Mu (the shared invoicing application) is composed from the installed bundle's manifest (.seb-bundle/apps/invoice-svc), as SEB ships it; Rho (the shared flows application) likewise from .seb-bundle/apps/flows; Sigma (the shared register) from .seb-bundle/apps/vega-svc. application_programs.vega names the one program psi's applications would call Sigma as (none holds it yet: a program of that name is created in psi's organisation when an application needs the register).
